I maintain my habit tracking logs in Simple Note. Export it in "~/downloads/habit_tracker.csv" in my file system. The rows for date column should be in yyyy-mm-dd format and the rest should be yes or no as per my logs. The rows should be sorted in ascending order of the date from top to bottom, and habit columns as per their order in logs.
